verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an API-driven SaaS, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question, but the evidence pack never documents one. The only direct probe found nothing: every candidate path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returned 404. The llms.txt index, markdown docs, MCP server and CLI are adjacent machine-readable surfaces, not an API specification, so they earn no credit.
